projectTitle: notehub-go: Go client for the Blues Notehub API
description: notehub-go, the Go module github.com/blues/notehub-go with package name notehub, is the Go client library for the Blues Notehub REST API at https://api.notefile.net, generated from the Notehub OpenAPI specification. It provides API services, request builders, and models for Notehub projects, devices, fleets, events, routes, environment variables, firmware updates, monitors, jobs, and usage data.
rules: Install with go get github.com/blues/notehub-go and import it as notehub "github.com/blues/notehub-go". The package name is notehub; the generated examples in docs/ alias it as openapiclient.

Authorize Notehub API requests to https://api.notefile.net with an Authorization: Bearer header carrying a Notehub personal access token or an OAuth bearer token. In notehub-go, set it on each call's context with notehub.ContextAccessToken.
The examples in docs/ call operations with a bare context.Background(), which sends no Authorization header. Pass context.WithValue(context.Background(), notehub.ContextAccessToken, token) instead.
Create a client with notehub.NewAPIClient(notehub.NewConfiguration()). Services are client fields with an API suffix, e.g. client.DeviceAPI, client.ProjectAPI, client.EventAPI, client.RouteAPI.

Each operation is a builder: pass ctx and required path parameters, chain optional parameters, then call Execute(), which returns (result, *http.Response, error), e.g. client.DeviceAPI.GetDevices(ctx, projectUID).PageSize(50).Execute().

Devices, Notes, Notefiles, and device environment variables are on DeviceAPI; fleets, products, firmware, DFU, and project environment variables are on ProjectAPI; events are on EventAPI; routes are on RouteAPI.
Model struct fields are pointers. Read them with getters such as GetDevices() and GetHasMore(), and take pointers to literal values with helpers such as notehub.PtrString and notehub.PtrInt32.

Copy service, method, parameter, and model names exactly from this SDK's docs/ files or the Notehub API reference (https://dev.blues.io/api-reference/notehub-api/); do not invent methods, parameters, or response fields.
